channel.title: AI Systems Architecture Handbook
channel.description: New and rewritten pages of the AI Systems Architecture Handbook.

item.title: Deterministic vs. Probabilistic Systems: What Changes for Architecture
item.description: How contracts, retries, caching, testing, versioning, and auditing change when a component returns a sample from a distribution instead of a computed result.

item.title: Tool Call Idempotency, Retry, and Compensation
item.description: Why agents duplicate side effects through retries and re-planning, how to derive idempotency keys from intent, and how to compensate a half-executed plan.
